items.item_text: Completion of an Accredited Surgical Technologist Program and or Certified Surgical Technologist designation from (AST or NCCT), upon hire and
Certified Surgical Technologist, upon hire or
Technologist in Surgery-Certified, upon hire and
Basic Life Support - CPR, upon hire
High School GED General Studies, upon hire or
High School Graduate General Studies, upon hire and
One year experience as an Surgical Technologist

Properly scrubs, gowns and gloves for all surgical procedures. Uses proper PPE for all situations. Promotes use of Ortho Garb. Employs excellent aseptic technique, Discards items with doubtful sterility prior to use in accordance with standards. Indicates breaches in technique, takes corrective action. Follows guidelines for usability of human and mechanical implants. Delivers and receives needed information to appropriate people concerning the case and possible changes.

Participates in planning intraoperative patient care for appropriate physician and consideration of patient characteristics. Sets up the operating room for procedures according to physicians preference card and surgical procedure scheduled. Obtains supplies needed for intervention including but not limited to special instrumentation and sutures as indicated by the procedure and patient Adjusts equipment, supplies and/or instruments, promotes maintenance of temperature, skin integrity, and communicates with patients in accordance with age specific needs or requirements. Counts sponges, sharps and instruments with nurse in accordance to unit policy. Passes instruments appropriately to prevent injury and contamination. Monitors needles, sponges and instruments to prevent loss or injury, discards sharps in appropriate sharps container. Receives specimens from surgeon, passes to nurse accurately identified. Prepares wound dressing appropriately. Assists with positioning and transfer of patients. Stocks suite ensuring constant readiness and availability of supplies. Assures all equipment is functioning before surgery begins. Marks non-functional equipment and report to Director. Checks tray menus and give appropriate feedback concerning tray preparation.

Assists with OR suite cleaning. Removes all exposed equipment and supplies from OR Suite prior to next procedure. Removes and disposes of soiled linens and waste. Re-sterilizes unused supplies. Cleans and decontaminates stationary equipment and furnishings. Returns all equipment to its proper storage location. Participates in conservation of supplies. Keeps rooms ready for emergency or unanticipated cases at all times.

Assists in the precepting and orientation of new staff members and students on the unit following departmental standards at all times. May act as a resource person to other staff members. Participates in ordering, stocking of supplies and maintenance of standard equipment and disposables per their assigned daily or weekly task list.

Applies the principles of asepsis in a knowledgeable manner to provide optimum patient outcomes. Understands and can demonstrate set up of sterile field. Initiates corrective action when breaks in techniques occur. Inspects sterile items for contamination before opening. Maintains sterility while opening sterile items for procedures. Discards any contaminated or suspected contaminated article. Understands and uses the concepts of universal precautions.

Active participant in OR quality initiates Used AIDET in all communications with patient, family and visitors Cooperative with SCIP initiative Supports NPSGs for proper patient and surgical site identification Supports recycling through Dignity Health elected company Reports broken or malfunctioning equipment takes action by tagging and removal from area. Participates in annual inventory as directed. Files event forms as necessary. Participates in development or maintenance of OR standards and policies. Assists with updates and maintenance of surgeons preference cards. Actively assists with Flash Log for proper tracking of flash loads.
Must be able to take call shifts as assigned - not required for MOSS.
